direct.label: Ballista LEFT — west wall!
direct.narrator_line: Gatekeeper! Aim the ballista left — they're massing on the west wall!

direct.label: Ballista RIGHT — east approach!
direct.narrator_line: Swing the ballista right — siege tower on the east approach!

direct.label: Elevation HIGH — the ridge!
direct.narrator_line: Gatekeeper! Elevation high — hit the archers on the ridge!

direct.label: Aim LOW — the battering ram!
direct.narrator_line: Aim low! Target the battering ram below the gatehouse!

direct.label: Raise the drawbridge!
direct.narrator_line: Raise the drawbridge — all the way up! Seal us in!

direct.label: Drawbridge to half!
direct.narrator_line: Drawbridge to half — let the scouts back in!

direct.label: Lower the drawbridge!
direct.narrator_line: Lower the drawbridge — sortie party, GO!

direct.label: Bar the outer gate!
direct.narrator_line: Bar the outer gate! Drop the crossbeam!

direct.label: Open the outer gate!
direct.narrator_line: Lift the crossbeam — open the outer gate!

direct.label: Bar the inner gate!
direct.narrator_line: Inner gate — bar it NOW! They're in the courtyard!

direct.label: Open the inner gate!
direct.narrator_line: Open the inner gate — reinforcements are moving up!

direct.label: FIRE the ballista!
direct.narrator_line: Fire the ballista! LOOSE!

direct.label: Wall brace to MAXIMUM!
direct.narrator_line: Mason! Brace that wall to maximum — it's buckling!

direct.label: Ease the brace to half!
direct.narrator_line: Ease the wall brace to half — we need the timber elsewhere!

direct.label: Wall brace to minimum!
direct.narrator_line: Mason! Minimum brace — pull the supports for the gatehouse!

direct.label: Release the wall brace!
direct.narrator_line: Release the brace entirely — redirect everything!

direct.label: Pour mortar — fill the gap!
direct.narrator_line: Mason! Pour the mortar — fill that breach!

direct.label: Raise the scaffolding!
direct.narrator_line: Raise the scaffolding — we need men on the parapet!

direct.label: Drop the scaffolding!
direct.narrator_line: Drop the scaffolding — they're climbing it!

direct.label: Shore up the buttress!
direct.narrator_line: Shore up that buttress — the tower is leaning!

direct.label: Release the buttress!
direct.narrator_line: Release the buttress — we need that timber!

direct.label: Hoist stones to the wall!
direct.narrator_line: Mason! Hoist more stones — the men need ammunition!

direct.label: Lower the stone hoist!
direct.narrator_line: Lower the hoist — enough stones for now!

direct.label: Stone route: main gate!
direct.narrator_line: Mason! Patch the stone route — main gate priority!

direct.label: Stone route: tower first!
direct.narrator_line: Mason! Reroute stones — tower repair takes priority!

direct.label: Stone route: breach repair!
direct.narrator_line: Emergency stone routing — all to the breach!

direct.label: Signal horn: code 88!
direct.narrator_line: Herald! Sound code eighty-eight — rally the reserves!

direct.label: Signal horn: code 42!
direct.narrator_line: Herald! Code forty-two — call for reinforcements!

direct.label: Signal horn: code 150!
direct.narrator_line: Sound code one-fifty — all-clear for the sally port!

direct.label: Emergency signal: code 200!
direct.narrator_line: Herald! Emergency — code two hundred! Final retreat!

direct.label: Raise the battle standard!
direct.narrator_line: Raise the standard! Let them see we still stand!

direct.label: Lower the standard!
direct.narrator_line: Lower the standard — draw no attention!

direct.label: Beat the war drums!
direct.narrator_line: Beat the war drums! Steady the men's courage!

direct.label: Silence the drums!
direct.narrator_line: Silence the drums — listen for their movements!

direct.label: Sound the retreat!
direct.narrator_line: Sound the retreat — fall back to the inner walls!

direct.label: Sound the rally cry!
direct.narrator_line: Rally! Sound the cry — every man to the breach!

direct.label: Gate cipher: 5-3-1!
direct.narrator_line: Herald! Gate cipher five-three-one — open the way!

direct.label: Gate cipher: 2-9-4!
direct.narrator_line: Herald! Cipher two-nine-four — the night password!

direct.label: Gate cipher: 8-1-0-7!
direct.narrator_line: Herald! Emergency cipher eight-one-zero-seven!

direct.label: Hold the drawbridge — FIRM!
direct.narrator_line: Captain! Drawbridge lever to seventy — hold the line!

direct.label: Drawbridge — MAX TENSION!
direct.narrator_line: Maximum tension on that drawbridge! They are battering the gate!

direct.label: Guard post — DAY watch!
direct.narrator_line: Captain of the Guard! Set the day watch — position one!

direct.label: Guard post — BATTLE!
direct.narrator_line: Battle stations! Guard post to position two!

direct.label: Guard post — NIGHT watch!
direct.narrator_line: Night watch! Set the guard — position three!

direct.label: Lock the dungeon!
direct.narrator_line: Lock the dungeon gate — prisoners below!

direct.label: Unlock the dungeon!
direct.narrator_line: Unlock the dungeon — press the prisoners into service!

direct.label: Open the sally port!
direct.narrator_line: Open the sally port — sortie party, move out!

direct.label: Seal the sally port!
direct.narrator_line: Seal the sally port! They've found it!

direct.label: Raise the alarm!
direct.narrator_line: Raise the alarm! All hands to the walls!

direct.label: Mix BLUE fever remedy!
direct.narrator_line: Apothecary! Mix the blue fever remedy — the garrison is falling ill!

direct.label: Mix RED wound salve!
direct.narrator_line: Apothecary! Red wound salve — the injured are piling up!

direct.label: Mix GREEN antidote!
direct.narrator_line: Mix the green antidote — the well may be poisoned!

direct.label: Tonic dose to 150!
direct.narrator_line: Apothecary! Tonic to one-fifty — the Captain needs it!

direct.label: Reduce tonic to 80!
direct.narrator_line: Ease the tonic to eighty — any more will dull his wits!

direct.label: Emergency dose — 250!
direct.narrator_line: Emergency dose! Crank it to two-fifty — he's fading!

direct.label: Issue the water ration!
direct.narrator_line: Issue the water ration — the men are parched!

direct.label: Cut the water ration!
direct.narrator_line: Cut the ration — we must conserve the well!

direct.label: Bind the wounded!
direct.narrator_line: Apothecary! Bind the wounded — get them back to the wall!

direct.label: Smelling salts — revive him!
direct.narrator_line: Smelling salts! Revive that man — we need every sword!

direct.label: Cipher code: 7-2-1!
direct.narrator_line: Scribe! Cipher code seven-two-one — decode the enemy dispatch!

direct.label: Cipher code: 4-5-1-9!
direct.narrator_line: Scribe! Code four-five-one-nine — the spy's message!

direct.label: Cipher code: 3-0-8!
direct.narrator_line: Scribe! Three-zero-eight — crack the enemy cipher!

direct.label: Map bearing — position FOUR!
direct.narrator_line: Scribe! Map bearing to position four — mark the enemy camp!

direct.label: Map bearing — position TWO!
direct.narrator_line: Bearing position two — mark the siege tower approach!

direct.label: Map bearing — position FIVE!
direct.narrator_line: Bearing position five — that's the relief column's route!

direct.label: Open the war ledger!
direct.narrator_line: Open the war ledger — what supplies remain?

direct.label: Close the war ledger!
direct.narrator_line: Stow the ledger — we've got the count!

direct.label: Read the spy report!
direct.narrator_line: Read the spy report — where is the enemy weak?

direct.label: Stow the spy report!
direct.narrator_line: Stow the spy report — we've got the intelligence!

direct.label: Seal the message!
direct.narrator_line: Seal that message — send it by pigeon before dawn!

direct.label: Tower sweep — EAST side!
direct.narrator_line: Watchman! Sweep the tower east — check the siege lines!

direct.label: Tower sweep — SOUTH wall!
direct.narrator_line: Watchman! Sweep south — what's moving along the wall?

direct.label: Tower sweep — NORTH ridge!
direct.narrator_line: Sweep north — movement in the tree line!

direct.label: Light the beacon fire!
direct.narrator_line: Light the beacon! Signal for the relief column!

direct.label: Douse the beacon!
direct.narrator_line: Douse the beacon — it's drawing their fire!

direct.label: East watch — eyes open!
direct.narrator_line: Watchman! East watch — report what you see!

direct.label: East watch — stand down!
direct.narrator_line: East watch stand down — redeploy to the west!

direct.label: West watch — scan the ridge!
direct.narrator_line: West watch — scan that ridge for siege engines!

direct.label: West watch — stand down!
direct.narrator_line: West watch stand down — pull back to the tower!

direct.label: Man the arrow slits!
direct.narrator_line: Arrow slits manned! Fire at anything that moves!

direct.label: War paint: RED — enemy!
direct.narrator_line: Watchman! Red war paint — mark the enemy position!

direct.label: War paint: BLUE — ally!
direct.narrator_line: Watchman! Blue paint — mark friendlies on the map!

direct.label: War paint: GREEN — safe path!
direct.narrator_line: Green paint — mark the safe route for the sortie!

direct.label: Patch orders: DEFEND WALLS!
direct.narrator_line: Castellan! Wire the commands — defend the walls formation!

direct.label: Patch orders: SORTIE!
direct.narrator_line: Castellan! Sortie orders — rewire the command leads!

direct.label: Patch orders: FALL BACK!
direct.narrator_line: Fall back formation — patch the command lines NOW!

direct.label: Patch orders: LAST STAND!
direct.narrator_line: Last stand — final command patch! No retreat! No surrender!

direct.label: Confirm the order!
direct.narrator_line: Castellan! Confirm that order — send the runners!

direct.label: Apply the Lord's seal!
direct.narrator_line: Apply the Lord's seal — authorize the command!

direct.label: Remove the Lord's seal!
direct.narrator_line: Remove the seal — revoke that order!

direct.label: Toll the warning bell!
direct.narrator_line: Toll the bell! All hands to battle stations!

direct.label: Call a war council!
direct.narrator_line: War council! Officers report — what is our status?

direct.label: Scan the ROYAL DECREE!
direct.narrator_line: Castellan! Scan the royal decree — authorize the order!

direct.label: Scan the WAR WRIT!
direct.narrator_line: Castellan! The war writ — scan it to mobilize!

cooperative.label: Tell Gate: ballista LEFT!
cooperative.narrator_line: Castellan! Tell the Gatekeeper — ballista to the left!

cooperative.label: Tell Gate: aim HIGH!
cooperative.narrator_line: Mason! Shout to the Gatekeeper — aim high, the ridge!

cooperative.label: Tell Mason: brace to max!
cooperative.narrator_line: Scribe! Tell the Mason — wall brace to maximum!

cooperative.label: Tell Mason: brace to half!
cooperative.narrator_line: Castellan! Tell the Mason — half brace, save timber!

cooperative.label: Tell Herald: signal 88!
cooperative.narrator_line: Gatekeeper! Tell the Herald — sound code eighty-eight!

cooperative.label: Tell Herald: signal 42!
cooperative.narrator_line: Watchman! Shout to the Herald — code forty-two!

cooperative.label: Tell Guard: lock dungeon!
cooperative.narrator_line: Apothecary! Shout to the Captain — lock the dungeon!

cooperative.label: Tell Guard: raise alarm!
cooperative.narrator_line: Herald! Tell the Captain of the Guard — raise the alarm!

cooperative.label: Tell Apoth: issue water!
cooperative.narrator_line: Mason! Tell the Apothecary — issue the water ration!

cooperative.label: Tell Apoth: smelling salts!
cooperative.narrator_line: Captain! Tell the Apothecary — salts, NOW!

cooperative.label: Tell Mason: brace to max!
cooperative.narrator_line: Captain! Shout to the Mason — brace that wall to maximum!

cooperative.label: Tell Scribe: cipher 3-0-8!
cooperative.narrator_line: Gatekeeper! Tell the Scribe — cipher three-zero-eight!

cooperative.label: Tell Scribe: bearing THREE!
cooperative.narrator_line: Castellan! Tell the Scribe — bearing position three!

cooperative.label: Tell Watch: sweep EAST!
cooperative.narrator_line: Scribe! Tell the Watchman — tower sweep to the east!

cooperative.label: Tell Watch: light beacon!
cooperative.narrator_line: Herald! Tell the Watchman — light the beacon fire!

cooperative.label: Tell Castellan: defend patch!
cooperative.narrator_line: Watchman! Tell the Castellan — wire the defend formation!

cooperative.label: Tell Castellan: Lord's seal!
cooperative.narrator_line: Apothecary! Shout to the Castellan — apply the seal!

open.label: Anyone — scan the NORTH wall!
open.narrator_line: Whoever has a spyglass — check the north wall!

open.label: Anyone — brace to MAXIMUM!
open.narrator_line: Whoever has a brace — maximum tension NOW!

open.label: Quick — signal code 75!
open.narrator_line: Any horn bearer — signal code seventy-five!

open.label: Someone — mix GOLD remedy!
open.narrator_line: Anyone with herbs — mix the gold remedy NOW!

open.label: Anyone — dial to post TWO!
open.narrator_line: Whoever has a dial — guard post two!

crises.label: BATTERING RAM!
crises.narrator_line: BATTERING RAM AT THE GATE! ALL HANDS — BRACE!

crises.label: FIRE ARROWS INCOMING!
crises.narrator_line: FIRE ARROWS! Take cover — at least four of you! SHIELDS UP!

crises.label: SIEGE TOWER!
crises.narrator_line: SIEGE TOWER ON THE WALL! Mason — brace the wall! Watchman — spot the approach! HOLD!

crises.label: SAPPERS TUNNELLING!
crises.narrator_line: SAPPERS BENEATH THE WALLS! Lock the dungeon! Scribe — find the tunnel! Everyone — STAMP!

narrator_lines: Hear me, garrison of Castle Aldric. I am the Castellan, and I bring grave news.
A great host marches from the south. Ten thousand strong, with siege engines and sappers.
Our Lord rides north with the army. We are alone. Reinforcements are three days' march away.
We must hold these walls. To your stations. God and Saint George defend us.

phases.narrator_intro: All hands, set your stations to ready positions. Confirm each control when your display lights green.

narrator_lines_ambient: Skirmishers at the tree line. Testing our defenses.
Steady, lads. Don't waste arrows on scouts.
They're probing the east wall — reinforce it!
Keep your heads down and your hands busy.

narrator_lines: The vanguard is scattered! Well done — they'll think twice before testing us again.
But scouts report the main host with siege towers. Prepare for the true assault.
They've found our weaknesses. The outer palisade is compromised.
The main army approaches and they know exactly where to strike. Brace yourselves.

narrator_lines_ambient: Siege towers rolling! Archers — fire at the operators!
The battering ram is at the gate — hold fast!
Boiling water from the murder holes! Pour it!
They're raising ladders on the south wall!
They know our weak points! Shore up the east wall!
The moat is filling with debris — they're building a crossing!
We're losing men too quickly — Apothecary, keep them standing!
Hold the walls! Do not yield an inch!

narrator_lines: Their siege tower is ablaze! The main assault breaks against our walls!
They're pulling back to regroup. Now — counterattack! Sortie parties, make ready!
The outer wall is breached! They're in the bailey!
Fall back to the inner keep! Bar the gates — defend the tower!
A sortie from the sally port cut their supply train! The siege engines are burning!
The enemy is in disarray — press the advantage! Every man who can hold a blade!
The keep's outer door is cracking. The courtyard is lost.
This is the last stand. Every man to the great hall. We hold or we die.

narrator_lines_ambient: The sortie is cutting through their camp!
Burn the siege engines! All of them!
Their general's banner is wavering — push harder!
Rally to me! One final push and they'll break!
They're in the courtyard! Archers — fire down from the tower!
Bar every door! Barricade the stairwells!
The keep must hold — fight for every corridor!
Do not let them reach the great hall!
The enemy is scattered — don't let them regroup!
Secure the outer wall before they return!
Their sappers are retreating — chase them down!
One more effort, lads! The day is nearly ours!
The walls are crumbling! Hold together!
Every man who can stand — to the barricade!
This is it! Fight for your lives!
If the keep falls, all is lost! HOLD!

WWW.title: Unbreached
narrator_lines: The enemy host breaks and flees the field! Castle Aldric stands unbreached!
Not a single enemy set foot within the inner wall. A perfect defence.
When the Lord returns, he will find his castle whole and his garrison proud.
God and Saint George have smiled upon us. Well fought, every one of you.

WWL.title: Scarred but Standing
narrator_lines: The enemy withdraws, but the inner keep bears the scars of a brutal final assault.
Castle Aldric holds. The banner still flies, though the walls are blackened.
A difficult end to what began as a masterful defence. But you held.

WLW.title: Desperate Rally
narrator_lines: After losing the outer bailey, a desperate counterattack retook the walls.
The enemy retreats in disarray. Castle Aldric is battered but unbroken.
A hard-won victory. The garrison earned its rest today.

WLL.title: Pyrrhic Hold
narrator_lines: The castle is a ruin. Half the garrison lies wounded in the great hall.
But the banner still flies. When reinforcements arrive, they find you alive.
A siege that started so well. What went wrong?

LWW.title: Finding Your Steel
narrator_lines: What a rally! A terrible start nearly cost everything, but the garrison found its steel.
The enemy is routed. Castle Aldric's flag flies proud over the carnage.
From the brink of defeat, you forged a victory the bards will sing of.

LWL.title: Stubborn Survivors
narrator_lines: Castle Aldric stands, but barely. Every wall is breached. The moat runs red.
The enemy withdrew at nightfall, too bloodied to finish the job.
You survived through stubbornness alone. The relief column finds a garrison on its knees.

LLW.title: Miracle at Dawn
narrator_lines: A miracle at the darkest hour. One final sally drove them from the great hall stairs.
The castle is a smoking shell, but it did not fall. Against all odds.
Do not let the bards embellish this. It was not courage — it was desperation.

LLL.title: Castle Fallen
narrator_lines: The great hall door splinters. The enemy pours through.
Castle Aldric's garrison lays down its arms. The siege is over.
When the relief column arrives, they find the enemy's banner on the tower.

between_commands_lines: Time is our ally — the relief column marches!
To your stations! No rest for the weary!
That is an order from the Castellan!
For Castle Aldric! For the Lord!
Every stone we hold is a stone they cannot take!
